customer_id.meaning: primary id of the customer profile

name.meaning: customer's full legal name as printed on the driver's license

phone_number.meaning: mobile number registered on the profile

email.meaning: email address registered on the profile (sign-in email for the Kestrel account)

date_of_birth.meaning: customer's date of birth as on the driver's license

ssn_last4.meaning: last four digits of the customer's Social Security number on file

residential_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the residential address on the profile

home_state.meaning: state of the residential address on the profile (two-letter postal code)

profile_opened_date.meaning: date the Kestrel account profile was created

purchase_order_id.meaning: primary id of the vehicle purchase order (one order = one vehicle for one buyer)

variant_name.meaning: vehicle program the vehicle is sold under, as the official program name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the order (basis: purchase lifecycle.states)

vin.meaning: 17-character vehicle identification number of the vehicle being bought

vehicle_description.meaning: model year, make, model and trim as listed, e.g. '2021 Honda CR-V EX-L'

listing_odometer.meaning: odometer reading disclosed on the listing when the order was reserved

handover_odometer.meaning: odometer reading recorded on the handover checklist when the customer took possession; empty until handover

vehicle_price.meaning: agreed vehicle price before fees and taxes (Kestrel no-haggle price at reservation)

payment_method.meaning: how the balance beyond the down payment is paid: buyer's own funds, a Kestrel Auto Finance contract, or a lender chosen by the buyer

selling_dealer_state.meaning: state of the Kestrel dealer license (hub) the vehicle is sold from

registration_state.meaning: state the buyer will register the vehicle in (residential address on the agreement)

transfer_distance_miles.meaning: road distance the vehicle must be transported from its current hub to the buyer's market; 0 when the vehicle is already in the buyer's market

insurance_verified.meaning: whether proof of insurance naming this VIN has been received and verified for the order

hold_expires_date.meaning: last calendar day the vehicle stays held for this reservation; moves later only through a hold extension

hold_extensions_used.meaning: number of reservation hold extensions granted on this order

contract_signed_date.meaning: date the buyer e-signed the purchase agreement; empty until signed

handover_date.meaning: date the buyer took possession (delivery completed or pickup completed); empty until handover

return_odometer.meaning: odometer reading recorded at the return inspection when the vehicle came back to Kestrel; empty unless returned

exchange_source_order_id.meaning: the returned order this order replaces in a 7-day exchange (foreign key -> purchase_orders); empty when the order is not an exchange replacement

closed_date.meaning: date the order reached a terminal state (completed, returned, cancelled, expired); empty while open

closure_reason.meaning: why the order closed; 'none' while the order is open

order_balance.meaning: amount the buyer still owes on the order (charges minus payments and reversals plus refunds); identically the sum of the order_balance account deltas; negative means money is owed back to the buyer

deposit_held.meaning: reservation deposit currently held by Kestrel and not yet applied or refunded; identically the sum of the deposit_held account deltas

purchase_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the order ledger entry

purchase_order_id.meaning: order the entry belongs to (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount of the entry, always positive; whether it raises or lowers the account is fixed by the event family's direction

charge_type.meaning: which charge a charge or charge-reversal entry concerns; not_applicable on other entries

payment_source.meaning: source of the funds on a payment entry; not_applicable on other entries

payment_channel.meaning: rail the money moved on for deposits, payments and refunds; not_applicable on charges

refund_type.meaning: kind of refund on a refund entry; not_applicable on other entries

reason_code.meaning: business reason behind a deposit refund, a charge reversal or a refund; not_applicable on original entries

source_txn_id.meaning: the original ledger entry this entry derives from (the deposit applied or refunded, the charge reversed, the payment refunded); empty on original entries

linked_reference_id.meaning: the record outside the order ledger that produced the entry: the finance contract for finance proceeds, the trade-in agreement for trade equity, the return request for return charges and refunds; empty when none

limited_warranty_claim_id.meaning: primary id of the included limited warranty claim decision

purchase_order_id.meaning: order whose included limited warranty the claim is made under (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

repair_order_number.meaning: repair facility's repair order number for the visit, exactly as printed

failure_date.meaning: date the failure was reported to the repair facility

decision_date.meaning: date Kestrel recorded the claim decision

odometer_at_failure.meaning: odometer reading on the repair order

component_system.meaning: vehicle system the failed part belongs to

repair_estimate.meaning: parts and labor on the repair estimate at the capped labor rate, before deductible

covered_amount.meaning: amount Kestrel pays the facility for the repair after deductible and caps; 0.00 when denied

deductible_amount.meaning: deductible the customer pays the facility on this claim; 0.00 when none or denied

rental_days.meaning: days of rental reimbursement approved with the claim

rental_amount.meaning: rental reimbursement approved with the claim

towing_amount.meaning: towing reimbursement approved with the claim

return_request_id.meaning: primary id of the 7-day return request

purchase_order_id.meaning: order the return is requested on (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

requested_date.meaning: date the customer asked to return the vehicle

return_type.meaning: whether the customer wants the money back or to apply the purchase to a different Kestrel vehicle

return_method.meaning: how the vehicle comes back to Kestrel

odometer_reported.meaning: odometer reading the customer reports at the time of the request

request_status.meaning: progress of the request: awaiting the customer's e-signed return authorization, authorized, withdrawn by the customer, or vehicle received and refund processed

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

delivery_order_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery or pickup appointment

purchase_order_id.meaning: order the vehicle is handed over for (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

variant_name.meaning: fulfillment method, as the official method name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the appointment (basis: delivery lifecycle.states)

delivery_zip.meaning: ZIP code of the delivery address, or of the hub for pickups

distance_miles.meaning: road distance from the fulfilling hub to the delivery address; 0 for pickups

time_window.meaning: appointment window on the scheduled date, local time

reschedule_count.meaning: customer-initiated reschedules of this appointment so far

original_scheduled_date.meaning: appointment date first booked for this appointment; never changes after booking

customer_miss_count.meaning: attempts on this appointment marked missed because the customer was unavailable

last_miss_cause.meaning: cause recorded on the most recent missed attempt; 'none' when no attempt has been missed

completed_date.meaning: date the vehicle was handed over; empty until completed

closed_date.meaning: date the appointment reached completed, refused or cancelled; empty while open

delivery_fees_due.meaning: delivery-related fees billed and not yet paid, waived or refunded; identically the sum of the delivery_fees_due account deltas

delivery_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the delivery ledger entry

delivery_order_id.meaning: appointment the entry belongs to (foreign key -> delivery_orders)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount of the entry, always positive; 0.00 on condition reports

fee_type.meaning: which delivery fee a fee or settlement entry concerns

settlement_type.meaning: how a fee was cleared; not_applicable on other entries

reimbursement_type.meaning: travel cost reimbursed under Fly & Drive; not_applicable on other entries

receipt_number.meaning: receipt or booking reference on the travel receipt the customer submitted; empty when none

condition_finding.meaning: finding recorded on the handover condition report

appointment_date.meaning: appointment date the fee or report relates to (keeps fees for different appointments apart)

source_txn_id.meaning: fee entry a settlement clears; empty on original entries

trade_in_id.meaning: primary id of the trade-in agreement (one offer on one customer vehicle)

customer_id.meaning: owner of the trade-in vehicle (foreign key -> customers)

purchase_order_id.meaning: Kestrel purchase order the trade is applied to (foreign key -> purchase_orders); empty when the vehicle is sold to Kestrel outright

variant_name.meaning: condition grade the offer is written at, as the official offer name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the agreement (basis: tradein lifecycle.states)

trade_vin.meaning: 17-character VIN of the customer's trade-in vehicle

trade_vehicle_description.meaning: model year, make, model and trim of the trade-in vehicle

offer_amount.meaning: current written offer for the vehicle (changes only by a regrade before pickup)

original_offer_amount.meaning: offer amount as first issued on this agreement; never changes, so a regrade's reduction is original_offer_amount minus offer_amount

offer_date.meaning: date the current offer was issued

offer_expires_date.meaning: last calendar day the current offer can be accepted

accepted_date.meaning: date the customer accepted the offer; empty until accepted

stated_mileage.meaning: odometer reading the customer stated when the offer was made

inspected_mileage.meaning: odometer reading recorded at pickup inspection; empty until pickup

keys_promised.meaning: number of working keys or fobs the customer declared with the vehicle

lienholder_name.meaning: name of the lender holding a lien on the trade-in, exactly as on the payoff letter; empty when there is no lien

loan_account_number.meaning: customer's loan account number with that lienholder; empty when there is no lien

pickup_date.meaning: date Kestrel picked up the trade-in; empty until pickup

title_received_date.meaning: date Kestrel holds a transferable title (paper title or electronic lien release); empty until received

closed_date.meaning: date the agreement reached settled, declined, expired or cancelled; empty while open

equity_balance.meaning: trade equity not yet distributed: credited value minus deductions and lien payoff, plus any negative equity the customer has covered, minus equity applied or paid out; identically the sum of the trade_equity account deltas (negative = customer still owes the shortfall)

tradein_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the trade-in ledger entry

trade_in_id.meaning: agreement the entry belongs to (foreign key -> tradein_agreements)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount of the entry, always positive (quote amount on payoff quotes; 0.00 on title documents)

adjustment_type.meaning: reason for a value deduction; not_applicable on other entries

payoff_good_through_date.meaning: last date the lender's payoff quote is valid; empty on non-quote entries

per_diem_amount.meaning: daily interest the lender adds after the good-through date, per the quote; 0.00 on non-quote entries

quote_reference.meaning: lender's payoff quote or letter reference number, exactly as printed; empty on non-quote entries

settlement_method.meaning: how negative equity was covered or positive equity was paid out; not_applicable on other entries

document_type.meaning: title document received; not_applicable on other entries

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the quote a payoff relies on); empty when none

linked_reference_id.meaning: purchase order equity is applied to; empty when none

finance_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the Kestrel Auto Finance retail installment contract or approval

purchase_order_id.meaning: purchase order the contract finances (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

variant_name.meaning: credit tier the approval was decisioned at, as the official tier name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis: finance lifecycle.states)

application_date.meaning: date the credit application was decisioned

approval_expires_date.meaning: last calendar day the approval terms can be signed

amount_financed.meaning: amount financed on the signed contract (vehicle balance plus financed add-ons and negative equity)

apr.format: annual percentage rate, percent with 2 decimals (e.g. 7.49)
apr.meaning: contract APR in effect, net of any autopay rate reduction currently applied

term_months.meaning: number of monthly installments on the contract

contract_date.meaning: date the contract was signed; empty while only approved

first_payment_date.meaning: due date of the first installment

payment_due_day.meaning: day of the month installments fall due

next_due_date.meaning: due date of the oldest installment not yet satisfied

maturity_date.meaning: due date of the final installment, after any deferrals

last_payment_date.meaning: posting date of the most recent payment that applied interest (simple-interest accrual runs from here); contract date until the first payment

autopay_enrolled.meaning: whether automatic ACH debit on the due date is active

stips_verified.meaning: whether every verification the approval required before signing (proof of income, proof of residence, references) has been completed

deferrals_used.meaning: payment deferrals granted over the life of the contract

due_date_changes_used.meaning: due-date changes granted over the life of the contract

closed_date.meaning: date the contract reached paid_off, unwound, withdrawn or expired; empty while open

principal_balance.meaning: unpaid principal; identically the sum of the principal_balance account deltas

fees_due.meaning: assessed fees not yet paid or waived; identically the sum of the fees_due account deltas

finance_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the loan ledger entry

finance_contract_id.meaning: contract the entry belongs to (foreign key -> finance_contracts)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount booked to the entry's account, always positive: principal portion on payments and returned payments, fee amount on fee entries, quote total on payoff quotes, 0.00 on deferrals

total_received.meaning: full amount of the customer's payment on payment and returned-payment entries; 0.00 elsewhere

interest_portion.meaning: part of the payment applied to accrued interest; 0.00 elsewhere

fee_portion.meaning: part of the payment applied to outstanding fees; 0.00 elsewhere

payment_channel.meaning: how a payment was made; not_applicable on non-payment entries

payment_type.meaning: what the customer designated the payment as; not_applicable on non-payment entries

fee_type.meaning: which fee a fee entry concerns; not_applicable on other entries

clearance_type.meaning: how a fee was cleared; not_applicable on other entries

credit_source.meaning: origin of a non-payment principal credit; not_applicable on other entries

installment_due_date.meaning: due date of the installment the entry relates to (the late installment for a late fee, the deferred installment for a deferral, the installment a scheduled payment satisfies); empty when none

good_through_date.meaning: last date a payoff quote is valid; empty on other entries

per_diem_interest.meaning: daily interest stated on a payoff quote; 0.00 on other entries

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the payment a return reverses, the fee a clearance clears, the payment that paid a fee); empty on original entries

linked_reference_id.meaning: record outside the loan ledger behind a principal credit (the cancelled service contract, GAP waiver or maintenance plan, or the purchase order on an unwind); empty when none

title_order_id.meaning: primary id of the title and registration order

purchase_order_id.meaning: purchase order the vehicle was bought on (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

variant_name.meaning: registration service type, as the official service name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the order (basis: title lifecycle.states)

registration_state.meaning: state the vehicle is being titled and registered in

lienholder.meaning: lienholder to be recorded on the new title

opened_date.meaning: date the order was opened (purchase agreement signing date)

temp_tag_number.meaning: number of the temporary tag currently on the vehicle, exactly as printed; empty before the first tag

temp_tag_expires_date.meaning: expiration date printed on the current temporary tag; empty before the first tag

temp_tag_extensions_used.meaning: temporary tags issued after the original one

submitted_date.meaning: date the most recent registration packet was submitted to the state; empty until submitted

dmv_transaction_number.meaning: state's transaction or receipt number for the most recent submission, exactly as issued; empty until submitted

registered_date.meaning: date the state issued the registration; empty until registered

plate_number.meaning: permanent plate number issued or transferred; empty until registered

completed_date.meaning: date plates and registration card reached the customer; empty until completed

closed_date.meaning: date the order reached completed or cancelled; empty while open

state_fees_held.meaning: state title and registration fees collected from the buyer and not yet remitted to the state or refunded; identically the sum of the state_fees_held account deltas

title_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the title ledger entry

title_order_id.meaning: order the entry belongs to (foreign key -> title_orders)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount of the entry, always positive; 0.00 on documentary entries

fee_type.meaning: which state fee a fee entry concerns; not_applicable on other entries

document_type.meaning: document received from the customer; not_applicable on other entries

tag_sequence.meaning: 1 for the original temporary tag, 2 for the first extension tag, and so on; 0 on other entries

temp_tag_number.meaning: number printed on the temporary tag issued; empty on other entries

tag_expires_date.meaning: expiration date printed on the temporary tag issued; empty on other entries

reject_code.meaning: state's reason on a rejection; not_applicable on other entries

reimbursement_reason.meaning: cost a reimbursement covers; not_applicable on other entries

document_format.meaning: form in which a document was received; not_applicable on other entries

document_date.meaning: date printed on the document received (statement date, card effective date, signature date); empty on other entries

citation_number.meaning: citation or state penalty notice number on the document the customer submitted, exactly as printed; empty when none

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the collected fee a remittance or refund settles); empty on original entries

service_contract_id.meaning: primary id of the KestrelCare vehicle service contract

purchase_order_id.meaning: purchase order of the covered vehicle (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

variant_name.meaning: coverage level, as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the contract (basis: warranty lifecycle.states)

contract_price.meaning: retail price of the contract paid by the customer or financed

term_miles.meaning: coverage term in miles added to the odometer at sale

deductible_usd.meaning: per-repair-visit deductible chosen on the contract

sold_with_vehicle.meaning: whether the contract was sold in the same transaction as the vehicle (signed together with the purchase agreement)

odometer_at_sale.meaning: odometer reading on the contract declarations page

coverage_start_date.meaning: date coverage takes effect (after any waiting period)

coverage_start_odometer.meaning: odometer reading from which coverage takes effect (after any waiting-period miles)

expiration_date.meaning: last day of coverage by time

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer reading at which coverage ends by mileage

financed.meaning: whether the contract price was included in a finance contract

finance_contract_id.meaning: finance contract the price was financed in (foreign key -> finance_contracts); empty when not financed

transfer_count.meaning: ownership transfers of the contract so far

closed_date.meaning: date the contract reached a terminal state; empty while in force

coverage_remaining.meaning: limit of liability still available for repair claims; identically the sum of the coverage_remaining account deltas

warranty_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the service contract ledger entry

service_contract_id.meaning: contract the entry belongs to (foreign key -> service_contracts)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount of the entry, always positive (approved amount on adjudications)

repair_order_number.meaning: repair facility's repair order number, exactly as printed; empty on non-claim entries

failure_date.meaning: date the failure was reported to the repair facility; empty on non-claim entries

odometer_at_failure.meaning: odometer reading on the repair order; 0 on non-claim entries

component_system.meaning: vehicle system of the failed part; not_applicable on non-claim entries

claim_decision.meaning: outcome of an adjudication; not_applicable elsewhere

requested_amount.meaning: repair estimate submitted by the facility for an adjudication; 0.00 elsewhere

deductible_amount.meaning: deductible applied on an approved adjudication; 0.00 elsewhere

repair_facility_type.meaning: kind of facility that performed the repair; not_applicable on non-claim entries

benefit_type.meaning: benefit a reimbursement covers; not_applicable elsewhere

benefit_days.meaning: days reimbursed on a rental or trip-interruption benefit; 0 elsewhere

cancellation_basis.meaning: refund basis on a cancellation refund; not_applicable elsewhere

refund_payee.meaning: who receives a cancellation refund; not_applicable elsewhere

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the adjudication a payment pays, the payment a recovery reverses); empty on original entries

cancellation_request_id.meaning: primary id of the service contract cancellation request

service_contract_id.meaning: contract to be cancelled (foreign key -> service_contracts)

request_date.meaning: date the customer asked to cancel (the cancellation effective date)

odometer_at_request.meaning: odometer reading the customer reports for the cancellation (from a dated odometer statement)

request_status.meaning: progress of the request: awaiting the customer's e-signed cancellation form, confirmed, or withdrawn

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

maintenance_plan_id.meaning: primary id of the prepaid maintenance plan

purchase_order_id.meaning: purchase order of the covered vehicle (foreign key -> purchase_orders)

variant_name.meaning: plan level, as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (basis: maintenance lifecycle.states)

plan_price.meaning: price paid or financed for the plan

expiration_date.meaning: last day the plan's visits can be used

expiration_odometer.meaning: odometer reading after which visits can no longer be used

financed.meaning: whether the plan price was included in a finance contract

closed_date.meaning: date the plan reached a terminal state; empty while active

visits_remaining.meaning: prepaid service visits still available; identically the sum of the visits_remaining account deltas

maintenance_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the maintenance plan ledger entry

maintenance_plan_id.meaning: plan the entry belongs to (foreign key -> maintenance_plans)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

visits.meaning: visits booked by the entry (always positive; 0 on money-only entries)

amount.meaning: money on reimbursements and refunds; 0.00 on visit-only entries

repair_order_number.meaning: service facility's repair order number, exactly as printed; empty when none

odometer_at_service.meaning: odometer reading on the repair order; 0 when none

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the redemption a void reverses or a reimbursement pays for); empty on original entries

gap_waiver_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP waiver addendum

finance_contract_id.meaning: finance contract the waiver is attached to (foreign key -> finance_contracts)

variant_name.meaning: waiver level, as the official waiver name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the waiver (basis: gap lifecycle.states)

waiver_price.meaning: price of the waiver included in the amount financed

sale_date.meaning: date the waiver was signed (finance contract date)

term_months.meaning: waiver term, equal to the finance contract term at sale

vehicle_cash_price.meaning: cash price of the vehicle on the finance contract, the base for the loan-to-value cap

amount_financed_at_sale.meaning: amount financed on the finance contract when the waiver was sold

closed_date.meaning: date the waiver reached a terminal state; empty while active

gap_txn_id.meaning: primary id of the GAP ledger entry

gap_waiver_id.meaning: waiver the entry belongs to (foreign key -> gap_waivers)

event_type.meaning: ledger event family of the entry

amount.meaning: absolute amount (benefit paid, refund issued, or approved benefit on a decision); 0.00 on filings and documents

loss_date.meaning: date of the total loss or theft; empty on non-claim entries

insurer_settlement.meaning: primary insurer's actual cash value settlement on a decision; 0.00 elsewhere

payoff_at_loss.meaning: loan payoff as of the loss date on a decision; 0.00 elsewhere

claim_decision.meaning: outcome of a decision; not_applicable elsewhere

source_txn_id.meaning: entry this one derives from (the decision a benefit payment pays); empty on original entries

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity verification record (one per customer)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed; once true it never reverts to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the handoff record

reason.meaning: reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
